## 📄 YouTube Description

What if aging skin, inflammation, acne, and poor treatment results were not just surface issues, but signals from the body asking for deeper healing?

In this episode of **The Aesthetic and Wellness Edge**, host **Bethany Gifford**, founder of New Era Intel, sits down with **Frances Vincen-Brown**, holistic aesthetician, Reiki master, herbalist, and educator with over 20 years of experience in integrative wellness.

Frances is the founder of **Massage and Skincare Solutions** in Boise, Idaho, where she and her husband have built a deeply loyal, word-of-mouth practice rooted in science, energy work, and whole-body healing. In this conversation, Frances breaks down how skin is the body’s largest eliminating organ and why emotional health, inflammation, lifestyle, and cellular aging all show up on your face.

You will learn:
- What **zombie cells (senescent cells)** are and how they impact skin aging  
- Why some clients do not respond to treatments despite doing “everything right”  
- How red light therapy, microcurrent, lymphatic drainage, and nano-needling help eliminate zombie cells  
- The difference between **senolytics and senomorphics** in skincare and treatments  
- How estheticians can stay within scope while offering powerful, science-backed care  
- Why integrative wellness creates stronger client retention and long-term loyalty  
- How to evolve your aesthetic practice without losing clinical credibility  

Frances also shares insights from her **continuing education course on Zombie Cells & Skin Health**, backed by 47 scientific studies and approved for aesthetic CE credits.

This episode is a must-watch for:
✔ Estheticians and spa owners  
✔ Wellness and integrative health providers  
✔ Anyone curious about aging, inflammation, and skin health  
✔ Practitioners looking to build trust, retention, and longevity in their practice
